dimensions.assessment: Affects the 19 Pueblos of New Mexico, current federal tenants on the land, and the Indian Pueblo Cultural Center.
dimensions.evidence: for the benefit of the 19 Pueblos of New Mexico.

dimensions.assessment: Transfers land into trust and conveys buildings for tribal use, providing local administrative and developmental changes.
dimensions.evidence: used for the educational, health, cultural, business, and economic development of the 19 Pueblos

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not mention any specific federal spending or revenue changes.
Involves a specific land transfer, property conveyance, and short-term lease arrangement for designated federal property.
dimensions.evidence: transfer to the Secretary administrative jurisdiction over the Federal land

dimensions.assessment: The land trust status and property conveyances are permanent, though federal tenant leases have initial terms up to 24 months.
dimensions.evidence: initial term not to exceed 24 months.

missing_information: Specific federal financial cost or appropriations required to execute the land transfer.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill transfers approximately 9.89 acres of specific federal land in New Mexico into trust for the 19 Pueblos of New Mexico and conveys related buildings to the Indian Pueblo Cultural Center. While meaningful locally for the tribes and federal tenants involved, its overall national impact is negligible.
